cross_site_table.site_mechanism_thesis: Each site's mechanical substrate (information structure, navigation affordance, image role) determines which axis dominates: reddit is text/forum-structure dominated, classifieds is visual product-identity dominated, and shopping is mixed form-action plus visual-variant dominated.
cross_site_table.cross_site_invariant: P-SoM is task-pool complementary where measured: P-DOM↔P-SoM Jaccard is 0.571 on reddit and 0.447 on classifieds, both <=0.7; single-phantom oracle lift is positive on both sites (+3.33pp reddit P-SoM, +2.56pp classifieds P-SoM). Shopping is unmeasured and listed as a data gap.

section5_narrative_anchors.reddit_substrate_claim: Reddit's forum hierarchy makes representation the first-order mechanism: AXTree depth and image-referential tasks push DOM into search loops, while flat marks and prompt priors open a distinct low-cost trajectory basin.
section5_narrative_anchors.classifieds_substrate_claim: Classifieds exposes why aggregate macro can mislead: P-DOM and P-SoM have DOM-like aggregate SR, yet their task pools diverge (Jaccard 0.447) and full SoM wins because image supplies product identity.
section5_narrative_anchors.shopping_substrate_claim: Shopping is sparse but mechanistically clear: Magento combines visual product/variant identity with brittle form interactions. The §105 swatch bug shows form-state tracking is an orthogonal scaffold failure, separate from visual recognition.
section5_narrative_anchors.cross_site_invariant_claim: P-SoM is always task-pool complementary where currently measured: P-DOM↔P-SoM Jaccard is 0.571 on reddit and 0.447 on classifieds, both below the 0.7 redundancy sentinel, supporting a routing-arm thesis even when aggregate SR is close to DOM.
